body_text:
If $V$ and $W$ have the same finite dimension, then for a linear
map $T:V\to W$ the following are equivalent: $T$ is injective, $T$
is surjective, and $T$ is an isomorphism. Equality of dimensions
is essential; without it, injectivity and surjectivity are
independent.
